name: ophthalmic-ai-evidence-portal
description: Static documentation and evidence portal for the ophthalmic artificial intelligence review.

scripts.test: npm run test:data && npm run test:unit
scripts.build: python scripts/sync_collaboration.py && python scripts/validate_data.py && python scripts/audit_public_output.py --stage source && astro build && pagefind --site dist && python scripts/audit_public_output.py --stage dist
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e:built
